HideContinueButtons.title: Hide Continue Buttons
HideContinueButtons.description: If true, the warning page continue buttons are hidden.

HideReportButton.title: Hide Report Button
HideReportButton.description: If true, the warning page report button is hidden.

DisableClearAllowedWebsites.title: Disable Clear Allowed Websites
DisableClearAllowedWebsites.description: If true, the clear allowed websites button is disabled.

LockProtectionOptions.title: Lock Protection Options
LockProtectionOptions.description: If true, provider toggles and provider settings are locked in the options page.

DisableResetButtons.title: Disable Reset Buttons
DisableResetButtons.description: If true, reset actions in the settings page are disabled.

DisableThirdPartyIntegrations.title: Disable Third-Party Integrations
DisableThirdPartyIntegrations.description: If true, third-party direct integrations are disabled and cannot be enabled from settings.

MetaDefenderApiKey.title: MetaDefender API Key
MetaDefenderApiKey.description: Managed API key for the MetaDefender integrations.

HideProtectionOptions.title: Hide Protection Options
HideProtectionOptions.description: If true, protection options are hidden from the popup and options page.

BforeAIPreCrimeEnabled.title: BforeAI PreCrime Enabled
BforeAIPreCrimeEnabled.description: Managed enabled state for BforeAI PreCrime.

AdGuardDNSEnabled.title: AdGuard DNS Enabled
AdGuardDNSEnabled.description: Managed enabled state for AdGuard DNS.

AA419Enabled.title: Artists Against 419 Enabled
AA419Enabled.description: Managed enabled state for Artists Against 419.

ControlDEnabled.title: Control D Enabled
ControlDEnabled.description: Managed enabled state for Control D.

RedFlagDomainsEnabled.title: Red Flag Domains Enabled
RedFlagDomainsEnabled.description: Managed enabled state for Red Flag Domains.

ManagedAllowlist.title: Managed Allowlist
ManagedAllowlist.description: Host or URL patterns that are always treated as safe. The end user cannot remove these. Examples: "intranet.example.com", "*.corp.example.com", "https://apps.example.com/portal".

ManagedBlocklist.title: Managed Blocklist
ManagedBlocklist.description: Host or URL patterns that are always blocked, evaluated before the threat providers run. Examples: "bad.example.com", "*.malware.example", "https://phish.example/login".

ProxyBaseUrl.title: Proxy Base URL
ProxyBaseUrl.description: Overrides the backend origin the extension sends lookups to. Must be an http(s) origin, for example "https://osprey.msp.example". When empty, the default public backend is used.

DeviceTag.title: Device Tag
DeviceTag.description: Opaque identifier for this endpoint, attached to reported events by later features. Has no visible effect on its own.

SiteId.title: Site ID
SiteId.description: Opaque identifier for the client organization this endpoint belongs to, attached to reported events by later features. Has no visible effect on its own.

DisableUserAllowlist.title: Disable User Allowlist
DisableUserAllowlist.description: If true, the end user cannot add any allowlist entries or exclusions, and existing user allowlist entries are ignored.

ManagedProviderSettings.title: Managed Provider Settings
ManagedProviderSettings.description: Per-provider overrides keyed by provider id. Each value may set "bypassBlockingThreshold" (boolean), "requestTimeoutMs" (integer between 1000 and 60000), and "blockCategories" (an object mapping a category key to a boolean).

BrandLogoUrl.title: Brand Logo URL
BrandLogoUrl.description: Image URL or data: image string used for the logo on the warning page and popup. When empty, the default Osprey logo is shown.

BrandProductName.title: Brand Product Name
BrandProductName.description: Name shown in the warning page banner and popup, replacing the default Osprey product name. When empty, the default name is shown.

SupportUrl.title: Support URL
SupportUrl.description: Support or help-desk URL shown as a contact link on the warning page and popup. Must be an http(s) URL, for example "https://help.msp.example". When empty, no support link is shown.

SupportEmail.title: Support Email
SupportEmail.description: Support email address shown as a contact link on the warning page. When empty, no email link is shown.

CustomBlockMessage.title: Custom Block Message
CustomBlockMessage.description: Optional override for the lead sentence on the warning page. When empty, the default block message is shown.
